newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodian king ends movie directing career.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian king ends movie directing career.

text.p: Cambodia's King Norodom Sihanouk said on Tuesday he had drawn the curtain on his film-making career after years of being panned and praised for his directorial efforts.
"Concerning my movie-making, I henceforth stop producing films and don't want to talk more on it," the king told a French journalist in a letter released by the royal palace.
A palace official confirmed Sihanouk was not making any films but said he did not know if this was temporary or the end of a hobby stretching back more than four decades.
Sihanouk has made some 30 films since his full-length feature debut "Apsara" was released in 1966. He starred in some of the movies and gave leading roles to relatives and close associates.
The films, often mushy love tragedies set in ancient and modern war-torn Cambodia, were panned by many serious critics but also won local and overseas prizes.
